source.name: Sport for Business: Canterbury Unveils New Ireland Rugby Kit Around 'Tougher Together' Campaign
source.quote: This is the first time that Vodafone has appeared on the shirt front of both the Men's and the Women's shirts
source.note: Named press coverage of the 2026/27 kit launch (3 September 2026). The Vodafone wordmark and logo fill the centre chest of the official 2026/27 home replica product photos (Intersport Elverys, www.elverys.ie/products/canterbury-ire-home-pro-jersey-26-green-1176139, all eleven views).

source.name: Sport for Business: Canterbury Unveils New Ireland Rugby Kit Around 'Tougher Together' Campaign
source.quote: Canterbury has unveiled the new Ireland rugby kit for the 2026/27 season, placing the relationship between players, supporters and the wider rugby community at the heart of the launch.
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The Canterbury logo sits on the right chest of the official 2026/27 home replica product photos (Intersport Elverys, all eleven views), opposite the IRFU crest.

summary: Vodafone across the front of the green Canterbury home shirt, with Canterbury as kit maker. All eleven official 2026/27 home replica product photos (Intersport Elverys) show only the Vodafone front wordmark, the Canterbury right-chest logo and the IRFU crest — the back, both sleeves and the collar carry no commercial marks. No 2026/27 Ireland home shorts product was listed at the official retailers checked (Intersport Elverys, canterbury.com, Rugbystuff.com), and the match-worn shirt was not verified by script.
